bio.text: Ikaika Olds was born and raised in Kailua, Oahu, and graduated from Kailua High School.
Olds enlisted in the U.S. Army after high school and served eight years as an infantryman, including two combat deployments to Iraq, and later earned bachelor's and master's degrees in psychology.
Before entering politics, Olds worked with homeless people in Honolulu, first at Waikiki Health and then at the Department of Education's Office of Education of Homeless Children and Youth.
